content.value_statement: Agent teams need repeatable ways to measure quality, regressions, and context changes. This skill guides rubric design, test sets, scoring, and monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Defines multi-dimensional rubrics for factual accuracy, completeness, citation accuracy, source quality, and tool efficiency.
Guides test set design across simple, medium, complex, and very complex agent tasks.
Explains LLM-as-judge, human evaluation, and end-state evaluation methods.
Provides Python examples for scoring, test sets, summaries, and production monitoring.
Recommends continuous evaluation, trend tracking, pass thresholds, and regression checks.
limitations: The included evaluator script uses simulated outputs and simple heuristics, not a production judge.
It does not provide hosted dashboards, storage, or automatic CI integration.
Rubric weights and thresholds must be tailored to each product and risk level.
It does not replace human review for ambiguous or high-impact decisions.

use_cases.title: Build Release Quality Gates
use_cases.description: Create rubrics and test sets that catch agent regressions before deployment.

use_cases.title: Compare Agent Versions
use_cases.description: Measure quality changes across prompts, models, tools, and context strategies.

use_cases.title: Design Evaluation Studies
use_cases.description: Structure benchmark tasks, scoring dimensions, and review workflows for agent research.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Rubric
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one agent workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multi-dimensional evaluation rubric for my agent. The agent handles [task type]. Include dimensions, weights, passing threshold, and review guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Test Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate test planning across complexity levels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a test set for [agent workflow]. Include simple, medium, complex, and very complex cases. Add expected outcomes and edge cases.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Evaluation Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for automated regression checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an evaluation pipeline for [agent system]. Include data collection, scoring, LLM-as-judge prompts, human review, pass gates, and reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Production Evaluation Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced monitoring plan for live agent systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my production evaluation plan for [agent product]. Identify missing metrics, sampling risks, alert thresholds, and human review requirements.

output_examples.input: Create a rubric for a research assistant agent.
output_examples.output: A weighted rubric with factual accuracy, completeness, citation accuracy, source quality, and tool efficiency. It includes score levels and a passing threshold.

output_examples.input: Design tests for a customer support agent.
output_examples.output: A test set grouped by complexity, including simple policy lookups, multi-turn troubleshooting, escalation cases, and ambiguous customer requests.

output_examples.input: Plan monitoring for a deployed agent.
output_examples.output: A monitoring approach with sampled interactions, pass-rate thresholds, score trends, alert rules, and periodic human review.

best_practices: Evaluate outcomes and process quality instead of requiring one exact execution path.
Use multiple rubric dimensions so accuracy, completeness, citations, sources, and tool use are visible.
Combine automated judging with human review for edge cases and high-impact workflows.
anti_patterns: Relying on a single overall score without inspecting dimension-level failures.
Testing only simple cases that do not represent real usage or long interactions.
Changing prompts, tools, or models without rerunning a stable regression test set.

faq.question: What does this skill evaluate?
faq.answer: It helps evaluate agent outputs, tool use, context strategies, and production quality trends.

faq.question: Does it include runnable code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a Python evaluator example, but the example uses simple heuristics and simulated outputs.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it replace human evaluation?
faq.answer: No. It recommends human review for edge cases, subtle failures, and high-impact decisions.

faq.question: What metrics does it emphasize?
faq.answer: It emphasizes factual accuracy, completeness, citation accuracy, source quality, tool efficiency, pass rate, and trend analysis.

faq.question: When should teams use it?
faq.answer: Use it when building agent tests, comparing versions, setting release gates, or monitoring production quality.
